scenes.title: Approach
scenes.heading: From Concept to Production
paragraphs: This presentation demonstrates a modular, data-driven architecture designed for rapid tailoring. Every scene, modal, and color is defined in a single JSON file — no HTML templates, no duplication.
Interactive bubble modals provide drill-down detail without leaving the flow. The system supports multiple roles by swapping the data file, while the rendering engine stays identical.

scenes.title: Architecture
scenes.heading: One Renderer, Any Role
paragraphs: The renderer reads a single JSON file and builds all scenes, modals, and navigation dynamically. Scene types include hero, standard, reversed, pipeline, and credits — each constructed by a dedicated builder function.
The line-drawing engine connects keywords in the text to interactive bubbles in real time, creating a visual map of how concepts link together.

scenes.title: Credits
paragraphs: Built with vanilla JS, CSS custom properties, and the native <dialog> API. No frameworks, no build step.
Fork this project on GitHub to create your own tailored portfolio presentation.

modal-bubble.title: Bubble Modals
modal-bubble.body: Each bubble in the media column is wired to a native <dialog> element. The modal content is defined inline in the JSON data file, making it easy to change or localize without touching HTML.

modal-multi.title: Multi-Role Ready
modal-multi.body: Switch between roles by changing the URL parameter: index.html?role=company-a. Each role gets a complete theme and narrative layer, while the rendering engine stays identical.

modal-engine.title: Renderer Engine
modal-engine.body: The renderer reads JSON and builds everything in a single pass. Scene types are dispatched to builder functions. The line-drawing engine uses SVG paths with cubic Bezier curves to create smooth, animated connections between keywords and bubbles.

modal-keywords.title: Keyword Linking
modal-keywords.body: A keyword span with a data-link attribute points to a bubble's ID. The line engine finds both elements, measures their positions, and draws a curved path between them. The animation uses SVG stroke-dashoffset for a clean reveal effect.
